# Natel

> Natel is a lightweight, self-hosted web app for editing contacts on an existing CardDAV server. It is open source under the MIT license and tested with Baïkal, Radicale and Xandikos.

Natel requires an existing CardDAV server and account. It edits contacts; it does
not host address books or provide calendars, tasks or offline mode. Its interface
supports English and French. The demo uses made-up contacts and resets edits on
reload.

## Project

- [Overview](https://natel.app/): Features, data handling and self-hosting instructions.
- [Source and README](https://github.com/KewinDousse/natel): Source code, requirements and quick start.
- [Demo](https://demo.natel.app/contacts): Try the editor with made-up contacts.

## Documentation

- [User guide](https://github.com/KewinDousse/natel/blob/main/docs/user-guide.md): Contacts, photos, groups, imports, exports and conflicts.
- [Deployment](https://github.com/KewinDousse/natel/blob/main/docs/deployment.md): Docker setup, HTTPS, configuration and updates.
- [Running without Docker](https://github.com/KewinDousse/natel/blob/main/docs/bare-metal.md): Build and run the app with Caddy and the session process.
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/KewinDousse/natel/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md): Tested servers and clients, group formats and known limits.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/KewinDousse/natel/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): Sign-in, server discovery, photos and support.
